KI/AI Nutzung an der Universitaet Bayreuth
Nutzung von ChatGPT et al. in der Universitaet Bayreuth

claimChanges.claimText: Microsoft Copilot is listed for University of Bayreuth in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

University of Bayreuth ITS advises that official Copilot login provides commercial data protection and no model-training assurance, but Copilot for Web/Edge is not recommended for personal or confidential data and prompts should not contain personal data or disclose confidential content.

University of Bayreuth ITS says members can use existing licenses to access ChatGPT and DALL-E through Microsoft Copilot with their University of Bayreuth bt account, and can also use GenAI open-source models through AcademicCloud.
University of Bayreuth points staff toward AI literacy and teaching support, including ZHL training formats for lecturers and ITS-listed online courses connected to the EU AI Act article 4 context.
The University of Bayreuth has central official pages discussing ChatGPT and ITS-supported AI access, but this crawl did not identify a central binding university-wide AI assessment policy.
